Method 1 (hand reproductions, incl. orchestrator check (a) - three required, I did five, Python probe in the muse tmp dir): (i) 64-tuple image-0102/image-0201 relations from qload/cx/qunload giving t^(db[a]&1) with cells [1,2]/[2,1], coverage 64/4194304=1/65536 - 0 mismatches over all 64 rows; (ii) hash failures sha256(raw 0102)=a12871fe..., sha256(raw 0201)=25dfd29c..., sha256(hex text)=f19ccf1e... - fixture carries the raw-byte hash, swapped/stale/hex-text all necessarily reject; (iii) restricted map (Z-I)|0>=0, unrestricted Frobenius squared 4, reduced input 1 x full output 2 Choi 2x2 zero, phase (-I-I)|0> squared norm 4 with zero uncontrolled Choi difference - all match restricted-map.json; (iv) packing 1f01 -> 5-bit cells [31,8] straddling a byte, 0xd1 padding bits 6-7 nonzero; (v) sampled-full-d xoshiro256** hand simulation outputs 0,45 covering both bits yet evidence. All published expected values I sampled are hand-derivable and correct; none appear copied from the implementation (generator uses closed forms; only object identity hashes come from the CLI, disclosed). Method 2: the diff touches neither the §3.6 step machine nor §7.4; instead I traced the claim-level inverse/discharge paths K85 affects - pairs09 rejects fixed_regions for inverse_pair, adjoint09 treats ProofRelativeToImage subclaims as unavailable, verify_certificate requires Proof for borrow_frames - no route lets an image-relative verdict discharge a full-D obligation. Method 3: SPEC-QUESTIONS.md has no K85/label/fixed entry (B-K85-2). Method 4: grep over changed files - no todo!/unimplemented!/TODO; new unwrap() at claims.rs:69,715 and unreachable!() in domain09 operate on values already validated by admission/inner checks (classified safe, suggested hardening); remaining hits are in tests. Method 5: list comparison - claim kinds dispatched {exhaustive,sampled,structural,numerical,channel} = spec §12.1 table; labels {proof,proof_relative_to_image,evidence} closed in V09 schema and check_requested_label; fixed-region fields {name,A,W,image,sha256} closed; 30 manifest cases = 30 .bisa fixtures, 28 D-cases (phase and restricted-map have no admission case, by design); CLI check remains admission-only as declared, no CLI replay claimed. Orchestrator (c): numerical/channel, scheduled and oracle-schedule paths all return Unverified with reasons on both verify_claim and verify_certificate paths and are never counted as Proof anywhere; preparation cannot be faked (closed schema rejects image_prepared). Orchestrator (d): no narrowing found - the only new rejections are requested-label mismatches the spec sentences mandate and malformed-image rejections at admission; evidence requests still accompany stronger outcomes. Tests I ran (headless env, private TMPDIR/CARGO_TARGET_DIR): cargo test --test isa09_fixed_image --lib: 7/7 and 34/34 passed; conformance --test ref_k85: 2/2; generate.py --check: 60 artifacts OK. PROGRESS's claimed full-crate/full-conformance runs (728 and 132 passed) were not re-run by me and are marked unverified here, but nothing in the K85 diff touches code they would exercise beyond the suites I did run. Verdict: accept (core and whole) with two spec-gap items for the spec owner; the implemented K85 surface is faithful, and every unimplemented part is declared and fails loud as Unverified/unestablished.
